highlights.title: Amazon service Bezos once called 'artificial artificial intelligence' is shutting down
highlights.description: Mechanical Turk launched in 2005 as a way to farm out tasks that are easy for humans to complete but too challenging for computers.

highlights.title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec as stream of high-profile departures continues
highlights.description: In a statement to TechCrunch about Malone's departure, OpenAI said it had "recently reorganized" its "infrastructure organization to support the scale and pace of our work."

highlights.title: Huawei Courts Egypt With AI Chips in Test of US Tech Diplomacy
highlights.description: Huawei Technologies Co. has pitched the Egyptian government on building AI data centers for military, surveillance and other public sector use, demonstrating its global chip ambitions and drawing alarm in Washington — where officials are working to assemble a counteroffer.

highlights.title: Self-hosted email is in steep decline, Microsoft and Google are taking over
highlights.description: Oh great, Big Tech is now in prime position to decide which messages get through

highlights.title: HP partners with U.S.-blacklisted Huawei for licensing the Chinese company's WiFi tech
highlights.description: It's a sign of adoption of Huawei technology outside China, despite the U.S. restricting the company from working with American suppliers such as Google.

highlights.title: Meta and State Attorneys Discuss Possible Mid-Trial Settlement
highlights.description: Meta and state attorneys general have discussed a possible mid-trial settlement of the landmark case in which the company is accused of deliberately designing Facebook and Instagram to addict teens, people familiar with the matter said. Bloomberg's Balazs Penz explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Meta, States Have Discussed Settling Teen Social Media Case
highlights.description: Meta Platforms Inc. and state attorneys general have discussed a possible mid-trial settlement of a blockbuster case accusing the company of deliberately designing Facebook and Instagram to addict teens, people familiar with the matter said.

highlights.title: SpaceX is building a $100 billion 'Starbase' launch site in Louisiana
highlights.description: 'We're preparing to build a spaceport that, until now, has only existed in science fiction,'

highlights.title: Blackbird Ventures on A$1.05B Fund Raise
highlights.description: Samantha Wong, Partner at Blackbird Ventures, discusses the firm's latest fundraise, which set a regional record with a A$1.05 billion fund. She outlines the firm's investment strategy and how it plans to back early-stage technology companies across Australia and New Zealand, capitalising on artificial intelligence themes and supporting startups with global ambitions. She speaks exclusively with Haidi Stroud-Watts on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Mindrank AI CEO on Business Strategy, AI Drug Discovery
highlights.description: Niu Zhangming, Founder and CEO at AI biotech firm Mindrank AI, discusses the company's business strategy and the role of AI in drug discovery. He speaks with Minmin Low on the sidelines of the Asia Innovation and Technology Enterprises Going Global Summit in Hong Kong. (Source: Bloomberg)
